goal.request: Prevent one-session reverse analysis from silently losing material human appearance, skin, lighting, and portrait-aesthetic evidence by routing independent topic lanes, enforcing source-relative appearance decisions, preserving primary roles, composing stable partial surface axes, and scoping displayed-tone and broad prior controls without case defaults.

evidence.claim: The user judges the latest reconstruction materially different in broad population appearance, nationality or regional reading, skin color, and aesthetic, and suspects vague human analysis plus a single serial context caused omissions.

evidence.claim: The motivating source and delivered render preserve much of the pose and composition but visibly diverge in the person's broad reading and in regional value/light response; these images are regression evidence only.

The exact prior plan marked a readable human person prior omit with high confidence because local geometry was said sufficient, but carried no drift-risk, geometry-sufficiency link, omission counterfactual, frame-versus-fidelity salience, or identity-context split. Its controlled skin descriptor discarded stable value, chroma, and finish because undertone was unresolved.

The exact prior prompt emitted generic fine-art portrait shorthand and an unscoped deep shadow floor while the compact broad person approximation was absent; stable skin axes appeared as loose prose rather than a validated partial wrapper.

The inherited spatial-orientation working tree passed 172 tests and module validation at 37 modules, 16940 runtime words, and the exact 3800-word Tier-0 cap, but had no lane routing, bundle validator, appearance-v2 omission gate, role-continuity check, partial descriptor, or displayed-tone scope gate.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Every material analysis topic reaches an isolated lane report and explicit integration disposition; readable fidelity-material human appearance cannot be weakly omitted; stable surface axes survive uncertainty in another axis; primary roles, broad prior decomposition, and regional tone scope survive into owned controls.
perceptual_contract.user_appeal: Reconstruct the same broad person reading, skin appearance, lighting, and portrait sensibility as the source without asserting unsupported factual identity or installing one image's labels as defaults.

invariants.statement: Routed domain topics are analyzed in separate bounded contexts, integrated by semantic ownership, and independently checked for route gaps, merge loss, unsupported additions, role drift, and scope leakage.

Human appearance separates frame prominence, fidelity salience, trusted identity context, non-identifying generation approximation, model-default drift risk, local form geometry, and omission counterfactual.

Stable surface axes may emit without inventing unresolved axes, displayed tone remains region-scoped with protected regions, and broad aesthetic shorthand cannot add uncalibrated content beyond literal causal controls.
No motivating nationality, race, skin value, undertone, pose, garment, lighting direction, portrait label, region coordinate, or desired wording becomes a runtime default.
causal_controls: causal holdouts across human and non-human routes

flexible_dimensions: the number of active lanes selected from current facets
current-source person approximation or explicit uncertainty
which surface axes are stable, bounded, or unresolved
global, region, or declared region-group tone scope
source-supported aesthetic shorthand or literal controls only

mismatches.source_state: Appearance, spatial, color/light/material, capture aesthetic, and global composition are independently material topics whose omissions need explicit evidence.
mismatches.render_state: One session previously performed route, all domain analysis, merge, and prompt drafting serially with no topic-disposition artifacts or independent coverage critic.

mismatches.source_state: The readable secondary person can be fidelity-primary and vulnerable to a different model-default broad reading.
mismatches.render_state: A free-text high-confidence omit passed without emitted geometry sufficiency, drift-risk assessment, or omission counterfactual.

mismatches.source_state: Stable value, chroma, or finish evidence remains useful even when a different axis is unresolved.
mismatches.render_state: One low-confidence undertone forced the whole controlled descriptor to inconclusive, leaving stable axes outside the intended wrapper contract.

mismatches.source_state: Broad production aesthetics must decompose into visible controls, while darkness applies to evidenced regions and protects bright planes.
mismatches.render_state: An uncalibrated fine-art shorthand and unscoped deep shadow floor could influence identity-adjacent appearance and overall exposure without structured ownership.

hypotheses.statement: A single context that performs every routed analysis and prompt drafting can skip or demote material topics without leaving a machine-checkable coverage gap.
hypotheses.falsifier: The baseline produces per-lane topic dispositions, exact module/version coverage, integration records, and an independent critic result before prompt freeze.

hypotheses.statement: A free-text omit reason lets a readable fidelity-primary person's broad generation prior disappear even when local geometry is insufficient or model-default drift risk is high.
hypotheses.falsifier: The baseline rejects omit unless it links sufficient emitted form geometry, low drift risk, and a preserved omission counterfactual while keeping unsupported high-risk cases uncertain.

hypotheses.statement: Treating one unresolved surface axis as failure of the entire composite suppresses stable source evidence and weakens generator intent.
hypotheses.falsifier: The baseline emits a canonical wrapper from stable axes while omitting unresolved or boundary-only axes without invention.

hypotheses.statement: Primary-to-supporting demotion, uncalibrated broad aesthetic shorthand, and regionless displayed-tone language can jointly overpower source-specific person and skin evidence despite individually plausible clauses.
hypotheses.falsifier: The baseline enforces invariant-to-claim role equality, broad prior provenance/decomposition/calibration, and exact regional tone anchors with protected regions.

intervention.general_rule: Route selected modules into a small set of clean-context analysis lanes; bind retained findings to a canonical-hash integrated plan; validate lane reports, integration, adjudication, and an independent critic in every execution mode before prompt freeze. For humans, use human-appearance/v2 with independent frame/fidelity roles, externally sourced factual identity context, and evidence-bearing prior omission. Preserve invariant roles across face and body form, serialize only stable surface axes, keep neutral-boundary undertones diagnostic, require calibrated decomposition for broad aesthetic shorthand, and bind displayed tone to declared affected/protected regions and exact non-trivial anchors.
intervention.generalization_basis: The intervention operates on route selectors, source hashes, topic dispositions, semantic owner keys, evidence/confidence, role, causal origin, drift risk, geometry links, counterfactuals, classified axes, calibration provenance, and region scope. Lane files contain no domain target values and existing modules remain the single source of visual-analysis rules. Holdouts include generic, human, product, screenshot/information, color/light, and non-human surface paths.

decision.rationale: The candidate mechanically rejects the previously silent coverage, weak appearance omission, role demotion, all-or-nothing surface composition, uncalibrated broad style prior, and unscoped displayed-tone paths across unrelated fixtures. No post-change image or user judgment was collected in this turn, so render and aesthetic promotion remain unscored.
